basis: renders the Fieldset primitive — a native <fieldset><legend> group naming the section.

responsive.basis: the field grid's gap scale steps at Tailwind's sm (gap-2 sm:gap-3 and up) — the spacing between fields is the contract, witnessed at both bands.

exceptions.because: the group's traversal belongs to the controls slotted into it; form-section.e2e.ts now witnesses Tab passage through its fields in a browser, but the keyboard family's own duties (aria-hidden-focus, scrollable-region-focusable) stay unproven — the role-axis evidence tranche owns un-qualifying this row
e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432)

interaction.basis: a titled, described group around fields — the group's own acts are naming and wiring.
